summary_en: The caller wanted 100 visiting cards and asked about the price. The agent explained that standard paper cards cost ₹200 per 100 and matte-finish cards cost ₹350 per 100, with a minimum order quantity of 100 cards. The caller clarified that they wanted visiting cards, not mugs, and asked which preference had been recorded. The agent confirmed that visiting cards were recorded and noted the caller did not want mugs. The caller said their questions were answered and ended the call. No specific card finish or order was selected, and no purchase was completed.
